name: Stiletto heel
summary: The court shoe on a thin heel of 7 to 12 cm, held by a steel shank. It has a long, narrow vamp, a pointed toe and a heel no wider than a pencil at the tip.

philosophy.core_thesis: A thin steel-cored heel lifts the heel and lengthens the leg, so the shoe is about line, balance and the arch of the foot.
design_principles: Set the heel at 7 to 12 cm, and thin it to 1 cm or less at the tip.
Core the heel with a steel rod, so that it carries the weight of the body.
Fit a steel shank in the arch, so that the sole does not sag.
Cut a long, pointed vamp; show the toe cleft or a small toe cover.
Set the heel straight under the centre of the heel bone.
Cut the throat low so that the instep shows.
Cover the shoe in one material and one colour, with a matched heel.
anti_patterns: A shoe with decoration on every part
A flat, soft sole that bends at the arch

silhouette.shape: A long, narrow shoe, with a pointed toe and a thin heel that carries the line of the leg.
silhouette.line: A single curve from the toe through the arch to the heel; the foot is nearly vertical at the heel.
silhouette.fit: Close and tight at the heel and the side, held by a deep heel cup and a firm shank.
silhouette.proportion: Heel 7 to 12 cm; heel tip under 1 cm; the toe point about 6 cm beyond the ball of the foot.
rules: Keep the heel under the centre of the foot.
Cut the throat low and the vamp long.
Cover the heel in the same material as the shoe.
Finish a point with a thin, even edge.

fabrics.rule: Use fine kid or suede for day, patent or satin for evening, and a steel rod and shank to carry the heel. The rubber top piece is the only rubber part.

methods: steel shank riveted in the arch
steel rod cast in the heel
hand lasting on a high-heeled last
construction.closures: A slip-on court shoe, or an ankle strap with a small buckle on a sandal.
construction.details: A pointed toe, a thin steel-cored heel with a rubber top piece, a low throat, a covered heel and a padded insole.

surface.pattern: Plain; a single colour, a bow or a small buckle for display.
surface.gloss: Suede at 2–5 GU; kid at 10–25 GU; patent at 80–95 GU.
surface.wear: The style wants a new, clean shoe; a worn heel tip or a scuffed toe spoils the line.

palette.strategy: Black, nude and red, with a deep jewel colour for the evening.

processes: pattern cutting on a high-heeled last
making.scale: Haute couture shoes made by a few houses, then, from the 1950s, factory lines in Italy, France and the United States.
making.signs: A thin even heel, a smooth upper with no wrinkles, a firm shank and a clean edge.

pieces.form: Black kid court shoe with a 10 cm heel
Patent pointed court shoe with a thin heel
Satin evening sandal with an ankle strap
Beaded satin mule on a spike heel
Suede ankle boot with a pointed toe and a thin heel

canonical_works.work: Pointed court shoe with thin heel

evidence.title: High heel shoes worn by Marilyn Monroe in Montreal, 1957 - Bata Shoe Museum -...

emotion.target_response: A sense of poise and danger: a sharp line that shows height, balance and control.

use_cases: a fashion image prompt for an evening shoe
a museum label for a mid-century shoe
avoid_when: the brief wants a flat or comfortable shoe
the brief is a men's dress shoe

modifiers.how: Add a 5 cm platform, widen the heel, and use patent or glitter in a bright colour.
Round the toe, add a T-strap, and lower the heel to 6 cm.

ornament_level.note: A stiletto carries one decoration at most: a bow, a buckle or a few beads.
